chunks: Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Seek forgiveness of Allah in the Witr prayer seventy times.

key_terms.اسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ: Seek forgiveness of Allah, a form of supplication asking for divine pardon.
key_terms.الْوَتْرِ: The Witr prayer, an optional night prayer performed in odd numbers of units.
key_terms.سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً: Seventy times, specifying the quantity of the recommended recitation.

ai.seo_question: How many times should one seek forgiveness during the Witr prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) prescribes reciting Istighfar seventy times during the Witr prayer, emphasizing the importance of seeking forgiveness as a spiritual preparation for the concluding optional prayer of the night. This practice reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of integrating remembrance (dhikr) and repentance into the structure of voluntary worship to purify the soul before sleep. The specific number highlights the meticulous attention to detail in the transmission of prophetic and imamic practices within the Usuli school.
